summary: 21Shares Polkadot ETF filed an 8-K reporting termination of a material definitive agreement — the Pricing Benchmark Licensing Agreement with CF Benchmarks Ltd., effective August 31, 2026, in connection with a planned transition to FTSE International Limited as benchmark provider. The agreement provided a non-exclusive, non-transferable, perpetual license to use the CME CF Polkadot Dollar Reference Rate for daily NAV calculation. No financial terms, premiums, or shareholder impact are disclosed. This is a routine vendor switch, not a special situation. What to watch: regulatory and operational execution of FTSE benchmark integration; no risk-arb angle.
